name: National Museum, New Delhi
accessibility_features: Anubhav Tactile Gallery for Visually Impaired
description: India's premier cultural repository housing over 200,000 works of art spanning 5,000 years of civilization, from the Indus Valley Dancing Girl to sacred Buddhist relics and Mughal miniature paintings.

name: Government Museum Chennai (Egmore)
description: Established in 1851, India's second oldest museum houses the world's most famous collection of Chola Bronzes, including the iconic Nataraja, alongside the Amaravati Buddhist sculptural gallery.

name: Bihar Museum, Patna
description: State-of-the-art Maki and Associates designed world-class museum celebrating the deep heritage of ancient Magadha, Pataliputra, and the Mauryan masterpiece Didarganj Yakshi.

name: Sarnath Archaeological Museum
accessibility_features: Ramp Access to Main Central Hall
description: Oldest site museum of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), housing the original 3rd century BCE Lion Capital of Ashoka (National Emblem of India) and masterworks of Gupta Buddhist art.

name: Indian Museum, Kolkata
description: Founded in 1814 by the Asiatic Society of Bengal, it is the ninth oldest museum in the world and the largest in India, featuring monumental Bharhut Buddhist railings, fossils, and antiquities.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS)

vernacular_names.mr: छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज वस्तु संग्रहालय, मुंबई

address: 159-161 Mahatma Gandhi Road, Kala Ghoda, Fort

opening_hours.timings: Open 7 Days a week (10:15 AM – 6:00 PM)

description: UNESCO-recognized Indo-Saracenic masterpiece holding over 70,000 treasures of Indian art, Himalayan bronzes, European paintings, and natural history specimens in South Mumbai.

name: Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum (VITM)
description: Dynamic interactive science centre with full-scale Wright Brothers simulator, Engine Hall, Space Gallery, and hands-on technological experiments in Cubbon Park.

name: Salar Jung Museum
description: One of the world's largest one-man art collections, featuring the famous 19th-century Musical Clock, the Veiled Rebecca marble statue, and royal Nizami jade and weaponry.

name: Albert Hall Museum (Central Museum), Jaipur

opening_hours.timings: Open Daily (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Night Viewing 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM)

description: Oldest museum in Rajasthan, designed by Sir Samuel Swinton Jacob in Indo-Saracenic style, renowned for its 2,300-year-old Egyptian mummy Tutu, exquisite Persian carpets, miniature paintings, and brass metalwork.

name: Calico Museum of Textiles, Ahmedabad

opening_hours.timings: Thursday to Tuesday (10:30 AM – 1:00 PM, Guided Tour Only)

description: World's foremost museum dedicated to Indian textiles, housing an incomparable collection of Mughal court textiles, Pichhwai temple hangings, tie-dyed Patola silks, and historic regional handloom techniques.

name: Napier Museum, Thiruvananthapuram
address: Museum Compound, Kanakakkunnu, LMS Vellayambalam Road
description: 19th-century landmark exhibiting a unique Indo-Saracenic architectural blend of Gothic and Kerala wooden roof styling, featuring ancient bronze idols, Kathakali dance ornaments, and ivory carvings.
source: Department of Museums and Zoos, Kerala

name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum, Pune
address: 1377-78, Kamal Kunj, Natu Baug, Off Bajirao Road, Shukrawar Peth
description: Extraordinary 20,000-piece collection curated by Dr. D.G. Kelkar showcasing everyday 18th and 19th-century Indian craftsmanship, including Mastani Mahal reconstruction, musical instruments, carved wooden doors, and ornate lamps.

name: City Palace Museum, Udaipur

opening_hours.timings: Open 7 Days a Week (9:00 AM – 9:00 PM)

description: Monumental 400-year-old palace complex overlooking Lake Pichola, housing the Maharana Mewar historical collections including royal armory, silver pavilions, Mewar miniature paintings, and crystal gallery.

name: Don Bosco Museum of Indigenous Cultures, Shillong

vernacular_names.en: Don Bosco Centre for Indigenous Cultures, Shillong

address: Mawlai Phudmuri, Near Sacred Heart Church
description: Asia's largest cultural museum dedicated to the indigenous tribal heritage of the Eight Sister States of North East India, featuring 17 specialty galleries of traditional attire, weaponry, crafts, and musical instruments.
source: Don Bosco Centre for Indigenous Cultures

name: Goa State Museum, Panaji
address: Old Secretariat Building, Adil Shah Palace, MG Road
description: Located in the historic Adil Shah Palace, preserving Goa's unique synthesis of Hindu Kadamba stone sculptures, Christian Indo-Portuguese sacred art, numismatics, and freedom struggle archives.
source: Directorate of Museum, Government of Goa

name: Archaeological Museum Lothal
address: Harappan Port Site, Saragwala Village, Dholka Taluka
accessibility_features: Tactile Model of Harappan Tidal Dockyard
description: Site museum at the world's earliest known tidal dockyard dating to 2400 BCE, exhibiting Harappan steatite seals, carnelian bead workshops, copper tools, painted pottery, and maritime trade weights.

name: Dogra Art Museum, Jammu
address: Pink Hall, Mubarak Mandi Palace Complex
description: Located inside the historic Mubarak Mandi Palace, housing the world's finest collection of Pahari miniature paintings from Basohli and Kangra schools, gold-plated illustrated manuscripts, and royal Dogra armory.
source: Directorate of Archives, Archaeology & Museums, J&K

name: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Manav Sangrahalaya (IGRMS), Bhopal

vernacular_names.hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय मानव संग्रहालय, भोपाल

description: Sprawling 200-acre open-air anthropological museum on Shamla Hills depicting the civilizational evolution of Indian humanity, featuring life-size tribal habitats, prehistoric rock art shelters, and ethnographic crafts.
source: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

name: Odisha State Museum, Bhubaneswar
accessibility_features: Ramp Access to Archaeology & Manuscript Halls
description: Renowned for holding India's most extensive repository of ancient illustrated Palm Leaf Manuscripts, medieval Orissan stone sculpture galleries, copper-plate grants, and traditional tribal musical instruments.

name: Assam State Museum, Guwahati
address: South End of Dighalipukhuri Tank, Ambari
description: Premier ethnographic and archaeological museum of Northeast India, showcasing 5th–12th century Kamarupa stone sculptures, Ahom royal weaponry, terracotta temple tiles, and tribal textile looms.

name: Hill Palace Museum, Tripunithura, Kochi
accessibility_features: Ramp Access to Main Palace Ground Level
description: Largest archaeological museum in Kerala, comprising a 54-acre complex of 49 traditional buildings built in 1865, exhibiting the royal throne and gold crown of the Kochi Rajas, Kudakkallu megaliths, and rare stone sculptures.

name: Government Museum and Art Gallery, Chandigarh

vernacular_names.hi: सरकारी संग्रहालय एवं कला दीर्घा, चंडीगढ़
vernacular_names.pa: ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਜਾਇਬ ਘਰ ਅਤੇ ਆਰਟ ਗੈਲਰੀ

description: Designed by iconic architect Le Corbusier, this premier institution houses world-famous Gandhara sculptures, Pahari and Rajasthani miniature paintings, and modern Indian masterworks.

name: The Partition Museum, Amritsar
description: The world's first museum dedicated to the memory of the 1947 Partition of British India, housing poignant personal oral histories, documents, letters, and refugee artifacts.
source: The Arts and Cultural Heritage Trust

name: Hall of Fame & Heritage Museum, Leh
description: Maintained in the high Himalayas of Leh, this museum commemorates the valor of Indian soldiers in high-altitude warfare alongside displays on Ladakhi culture, biodiversity, and royal history.

name: Himachal State Museum, Shimla
description: Perched on Inverarm Hill, this museum preserves rich collections of Pahari stone sculptures, bronze idols, traditional Himachali jewelry, weapons, and Kangra miniature paintings.
source: Department of Language & Culture Himachal Pradesh

name: Forest Research Institute (FRI) Museums, Dehradun
description: Housed inside a magnificent Greco-Roman colonial landmark, FRI features six dedicated museums of timber, pathology, entomology, non-wood forest products, silviculture, and social forestry.
source: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE)

name: Allahabad Museum, Prayagraj
address: Chandrashekhar Azad Park, Kamla Nehru Road
description: A National Museum under the Ministry of Culture, notable for its unique collection of Bharhut and Bhita terracotta sculptures, Chandrashekhar Azad's Colt pistol, and miniature painting gallery.
source: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

name: State Museum Hotwar (Ranchi Museum)
description: Jharkhand's chief museum showcasing tribal lifestyle exhibits (Santhal, Munda, Oraon), stone sculptures from medieval temples, terracotta figurines, and ancient metallurgical tools.
source: Department of Tourism, Art & Culture Jharkhand

name: Mahant Ghasidas Memorial Museum, Raipur
description: One of the oldest museums in central India (established 1875), exhibiting Sirpur Buddhist bronzes, Kalachuri sculptures, Bastar tribal crafts, and ancient inscriptions.

name: Manipur State Museum, Imphal
address: Kangla Pat, near Polo Ground, Thangal Bazar
description: Inaugurated in 1969 by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, this museum exhibits royal Meitei royal attire, gold-plated Hiyang Hiren (royal boat), tribal ornaments, and natural history specimens.
source: Department of Art and Culture, Manipur

name: Namgyal Institute of Tibetology & Museum, Gangtok
description: A world-renowned center for Vajrayana Buddhist study and Tibetan culture, housing rare 11th-century Sanskrit manuscripts, gilded bronze statues, ritual thangkas, and Buddhist antiquities.

name: Samudrika Naval Marine Museum, Port Blair

vernacular_names.hi: समुद्रिका नौसेना समुद्री संग्रहालय, पोर्ट ब्लेयर

description: Managed by the Indian Navy, this museum offers five specialized rooms detailing island geography, Jarawa and Sentinelese anthropology, marine ecosystems, coral biodiversity, and sea shells.

name: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum, Bhopal
address: Shyamla Hills Road, near Regional Science Centre
description: An immersive experiential museum celebrating the art, cosmological myths, architecture, and folklore of seven indigenous tribes of central India (Gond, Bhil, Baiga, Korku, Sahariya, Kol, Bhariya).

name: Mysore Palace Museum (Amba Vilas), Mysuru
description: Seat of the Wadiyar dynasty, showcasing royal ceremonial weaponry, the Golden Throne (Chinnada Simhasana), stained glass pavilions, and Tanjore oil paintings by Raja Ravi Varma.
source: Mysore Palace Board, Government of Karnataka

name: Bapu Museum (Victoria Jubilee Museum), Vijayawada
description: Modernized state archaeological museum displaying Satavahana and Ikshvaku limestone sculptures from Amaravati and Nagarjunakonda, medieval bronzes, weaponry, and rare pre-historic microliths.
source: Department of Archaeology and Museums, Andhra Pradesh
